description: This file implements kernel semaphore operations for Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, give, take, reset, and internal handling, with support for user space and polling.

methods.name: z_impl_k_sem_init
methods.description: Initializes a semaphore with an initial count and limit.

methods.name: z_vrfy_k_sem_init
methods.description: Verification wrapper for semaphore initialization in user space.

methods.name: z_impl_k_sem_give
methods.description: Gives (releases) the semaphore, potentially waking a waiting thread.

methods.name: z_vrfy_k_sem_give
methods.description: Verification wrapper for k_sem_give in user space.

methods.name: z_impl_k_sem_take
methods.description: Attempts to take (acquire) the semaphore with a timeout.

methods.name: z_vrfy_k_sem_take
methods.description: Verification wrapper for k_sem_take in user space.

methods.name: z_impl_k_sem_reset
methods.description: Resets the semaphore, unblocking all waiting threads.

methods.name: z_vrfy_k_sem_reset
methods.description: Verification wrapper for k_sem_reset in user space.

methods.name: z_impl_k_sem_count_get
methods.description: Returns the current count of the semaphore.

methods.name: z_vrfy_k_sem_count_get
methods.description: Verification wrapper for getting semaphore count in user space.
